rows: no CSR: signed by vCenter's own CA (VMCA): renew it in the vSphere Client > the host > Configure > System > Certificate > Renew
sections.text: A CSR is made where the key stays (vCenter, or the host) and attached to the certificate's incident, with what to do next. Signed by VMCA: renewed in vCenter, no CSR.
sections.title: Due - the incident and the CSR of each

subtitle: Due = expires within vmware_cert_warn_days (30) - DRY RUN: no CSR made, nothing sent to ServiceNow
title: VMware certificates (dry run): 3 due within 30 days (1 expired), of 4, 1 not checked
